title: Radiation and Weather Response Structure
description: Hierarchical structure of the Solcast radiation and weather API response. Used across /data/live/radiation_and_weather, /data/forecast/radiation_and_weather, /data/historic/radiation_and_weather, and /data/tmy/radiation_and_weather endpoints.

root.description: Top-level response envelope containing either estimated_actuals (live/historic) or forecasts (forecast/TMY) arrays.

estimated_actuals.description: Present for live and historic endpoints. Array of time-period data points ordered by period_end ascending.

forecasts.description: Present for forecast and TMY endpoints. Array of forecast time-period data points ordered by period_end ascending.

radiation-and-weather-data-point.description: A single time-period data point containing irradiance and weather measurements.

period_end.description: End timestamp of the time period in UTC. The primary time key for all data.

period.description: Duration of the time interval (e.g., PT30M = 30 minutes, PT60M = 60 minutes).

fields.ghi: Global Horizontal Irradiance — total solar radiation on a horizontal surface.
fields.ebh: Beam Horizontal Irradiance — direct beam on a horizontal surface.
fields.dni: Direct Normal Irradiance — direct beam perpendicular to sun.
fields.dhi: Diffuse Horizontal Irradiance — scattered sky radiation.

fields.wind_speed_10m: Wind speed at 10m height in m/s.
fields.wind_direction_10m: Wind direction at 10m in degrees from north.
fields.relative_humidity: Relative humidity at 2m as a percentage.
fields.surface_pressure: Atmospheric pressure at the surface in hPa.
fields.precipitable_water: Total column precipitable water in kg/m².

solar_geometry_fields.description: Solar position angles for the period.

fields.elevation: Solar elevation above horizon in degrees.

snow_fields.description: Snow-related measurements relevant to PV soiling.

fields.snow_soiling_rooftop: Estimated snow soiling loss factor for rooftop panels (0–1).

notes: Only the output_parameters requested are returned — not all fields appear in every response.
period_end is always present and is the primary temporal index.
Percentile fields (ghi10, ghi90) provide probabilistic uncertainty bounds.
Clear-sky fields enable computation of the clear-sky index (GHI / clearsky_GHI).
